fusions.name: Biting Cloud
fusions.desc: Looses 6 biters at once, spread apart, each dealing 2 damage.

fusions.name: Stripped Pasture
fusions.desc: A gnawing strike that deals 11 damage and makes the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Fed Cloud
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds. While it lasts, an escort of nature fights beside you, striking for 3 every 1.4s for 10s.

fusions.name: Stubble Left Behind
fusions.desc: Each time you kill an enemy, 20% of the damage you deal heals you for 6 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
